title: Friedrich Ebert Foundation: Scholarship for International Doctoral Students
summary: Financial and non-material support for international doctoral candidates admitted to a German higher education institution, promoting research and social commitment.

degree_levels.notes: Doctoral candidates / PhD students; doctorates in medicine are excluded.

subject_areas.notes: Doctoral projects in all academic disciplines are eligible with the exception of doctorates in medicine.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany

nationality.notes: Open to applicants who come from abroad and whose country is included in the application portal country list.

residence.notes: Applicants must come from abroad and be living in a country from the dropdown list when applying, and be enrolled at a German higher education institution.

mandatory.text: Admitted to a doctoral programme at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany
Very good command of German (at least DSH level 2, TestDaF level 4, C1 Goethe Institute certificate, DSD II, or telc C1 Hochschule)
Actively engaged in society and politics
Identify with the values of social democracy
Completed degree promptly and with above-average results
Pursuing a research project that makes a significant contribution to the field

funding.description: 1,500 EUR per month, contribution to statutory health insurance, networking within student and working groups, comprehensive seminar programme, participation in symposia.
funding.duration: Generally 3.5 years. In exceptional cases longer, but no longer than until the date of the final examination.

application_rounds.notes: Applications may be submitted at any time up to approximately 2 years before the dissertation is due to be submitted.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications may be submitted at any time.

steps.text: Use a desktop computer to access the application portal
Submit application via the application portal

sources.title: Friedrich Ebert Foundation: Scholarship for International Doctoral Students - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds international doctoral candidates for research at a German higher education institution.
